title: Find the display name of the user who owns the post with the highest view c
question: Find the display name of the user who owns the post with the highest view count among all posts whose owners have total views across their posts exceeding the site-wide average and who have at least one comment (on any of their posts) containing a URL. Also return the number of unique users who commented on that top post.

prediction.sql:
WITH user_views AS (
  SELECT p."XCL_033" AS uid, SUM(p."XCL_030") AS total_views
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p."XCL_033" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."XCL_033"
),
avg_v AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_views) AS site_avg FROM user_views
),
url_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_033" AS uid
  FROM posts p
  JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
  WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT uv.uid
  FROM user_views uv
  JOIN avg_v a ON 1=1
  JOIN url_users u ON u.uid = uv.uid
  WHERE uv.total_views > a.site_avg
),
top_post AS (
  SELECT p."XCL_026" AS post_id, p."XCL_033" AS uid, p."XCL_030" AS views
  FROM posts p
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.uid = p."XCL_033"
  ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."XCL_010") FROM comments c WHERE c."XCL_006" = tp.post_id) AS unique_commenters
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON u."XCL_052" = tp.uid;

WITH user_views AS (
  SELECT p."XCL_033" AS uid, SUM(p."XCL_030") AS total_views
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p."XCL_033" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."XCL_033"
),
avg_v AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_views) AS site_avg FROM user_views
),
url_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_033" AS uid
  FROM posts p
  JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
  WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT uv.uid
  FROM user_views uv
  JOIN avg_v a ON 1=1
  JOIN url_users u ON u.uid = uv.uid
  WHERE uv.total_views > a.site_avg
),
top_post AS (
  SELECT p."XCL_026" AS post_id, p."XCL_033" AS uid, p."XCL_030" AS views
  FROM posts p
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.uid = p."XCL_033"
  ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."XCL_010") FROM comments c WHERE c."XCL_006" = tp.post_id) AS unique_commenters
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON u."XCL_052" = tp.uid;

  SELECT p."XCL_033" AS uid, SUM(p."XCL_030") AS total_views
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p."XCL_033" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."XCL_033"
),
avg_v AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_views) AS site_avg FROM user_views
),
url_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_033" AS uid
  FROM posts p
  JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
  WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT uv.uid
  FROM user_views uv
  JOIN avg_v a ON 1=1
  JOIN url_users u ON u.uid = uv.uid
  WHERE uv.total_views > a.site_avg
),
top_post AS (
  SELECT p."XCL_026" AS post_id, p."XCL_033" AS uid, p."XCL_030" AS views
  FROM posts p
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.uid = p."XCL_033"
  ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."XCL_010") FROM comments c WHERE c."XCL_006" = tp.post_id) AS unique_commenters
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON u."XCL_052" = tp.uid;

    GROUP BY p.XCL_033
),
site_avg_views AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_views) AS avg_views
    FROM user_total_views
),
users_with_url_comments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_033 AS user_id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IS NOT NULL
      AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT 
        utv.user_id
    FROM user_total_views utv
    JOIN site_avg_views sav ON 1=1
    JOIN users_with_url_comments uwc ON uwc.user_id = utv.user_id
    WHERE utv.total_views > sav.avg_views
),
top_post AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS user_id,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count
    FROM posts p
    JOIN qualified_users qu ON qu.user_id = p.XCL_033
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
commenter_count AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.post_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_010) AS unique_commenters
    FROM top_post tp
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = tp.post_id
    GROUP BY tp.post_id
)
SELECT 
    u.XCL_057 AS display_name,
    cc.unique_commenters
FROM top_post tp
JOIN users u ON u.XCL_052 = tp.user_id
JOIN commenter_count cc ON cc.post_id = tp.post_id
